fact: The NSA Statistician General said the 2023 Population and Housing Census, Namibia's first fully digital census, showed the population exceeded three million.
The NSA says the 2023 PHC counted all persons present on census night 24 September 2023; enumeration ran 25 September to 6 October 2023 with mop-up to 30 October 2023 (population 3,022,401).
The NSA released the 2023 PHC Main Report on 30 October 2024, which it says contains final results; preliminary results had been launched in March 2024.
The NSA microdata catalogue lists the Namibia Population and Housing Census PUMS 2023 (microdata last modified 21 July 2026) and the portal shows 2023 census headline figures (population 3,022,401).

The policy cites data from the 2023 National Population and Housing Census, which found 4.4 percent of the population (about 108,992 people) living with a functional disability; the document gives no enumeration date, so the year 2023 is used.

The policy cites a 2011 Disability Report based on the 2011 National Population and Housing Census, published in 2016, with earlier counts for 1991 and 2001; the document gives no enumeration date, so the year 2011 is used.
The report says its institutional maternal mortality figures are consistent with those in the 2023 census report; it gives no enumeration date, so the year 2023 is used.
The NSA Statistician-General cited the 2023 Population and Housing Census as the country's first fully digital census; no enumeration date is given beyond the year 2023.
The presentation cites a population of 3,022,401 from the NSA 2023 Population and Housing Census.
Namibia Statistics Agency presents 2023 census results giving a population of 3,022,401, of whom 145,395 are non-Namibians.
The article cites the 2023 housing and population census report for household and phone figures, so a census was counted in 2023.
The 2023 housing and population census report is cited as stating household internet and phone ownership figures, so results are published.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Demographic and Health Survey 2013 as Namibia's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list an expenditure survey/budget survey (ES/BS), 2015, as the source of Namibia's most recent income and expenditure data.
The Namibia Statistics Agency states it has released the 2023 Population and Housing Census Report and a 2023 census public use microdata sample.
The Namibia Statistics Agency says census summary tables were released in October 2024, January 2025 and July 2026, following the 2023 Population and Housing Census Report.
